source.label: FY2026 Form 20-F, Item 7.A major shareholders
source.quote: According to Toyota's register of shareholders, as of March 31, 2026, there were 1,272,096 holders of common stock of record worldwide.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); matched to Toyota Motor Corp (7203), not Toyota Industries. CalPERS: its Form 13F information table for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 lists no shares or ADRs of Toyota (searched by name and ADR CUSIP). Holders of record: worldwide holders of record per Toyota's own share register at March 31, 2026 (not the U.S.-only ADS count of 1,679 holders of record also given).
